mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies and 80 degree weather by the Verona Public Library, while our New Moon phase arrives alongside an overnight low of 67 degrees and some expected rain.

The Senior Center is seeking reliable volunteers for programs, requiring a two-shift monthly commitment and a criminal background check, while the City of Verona has also released notices regarding the upcoming August partisan primary.
There is a busy schedule ahead including live music at Bailey's Run today and at Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market and music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow.

In our weekly report, officers handled a variety of calls, including an incident on Wednesday, August 6, where a 49-year-old was arrested for a fourth offence O W I after being observed driving erratically.
The flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough, available until Culver's closes at 10:30 PM tonight, so be sure to stop in and grab a scoop.
